svg.title: Integrated multiplier
svg.text: DCCREG turbine: the multiplier stacked into the doubler, run bipolar, feeding the rings — PROPOSED (2026-10-10)

The designer's ladder C3–C6 / D5–D8 as sketched; chain 2 reversed (D2, D4, D5, D8): side A negative, side B positive; C1 / C2 in phase; one stage past each varicap node to its ring. As built, ideal diodes.
blue: the chain that charges ring B (side B, positive) · red: the chain that charges ring A (side A, negative) · rev.: reversed against the sketch · new: added for the rings
side B, in phase with C1
REF: the counter-rotor's stator vanes; one inner bearing to the shaft carries 0.02 µA rms (the record's 165 µA)
7.60 kV/cm at the null, B to A
ripple 0.006 kV/cm p-p · the null at 0 V by symmetry
the record as built: 7.06 kV/cm (±13.86 kV)
the designer's ladder (C3–C6 180 pF, D5–D8), bipolar: chain 2 reversed; C1 / C2 in phase (in antiphase it does not pump); each chain one stage past its varicap node to its ring
nodes 1 / 4 at the clamps' −13.2 / +13.2 kV (V_op of record); the rings −14.93 / +14.93 kV, 7.60 kV/cm at the null (the record as built ±13.86 kV, 7.06 kV/cm)
12 HV sticks, one a position, reverse ≤ 6.8 kV (the record: 14, its D3 / D4 13.2 kV on two each)
Ca / Cb now hold 13.2 kV (the record's 6.9); C5 / C6 12.8, C3 / C4 9.0, C7 / C8 6.9, Csa / Csb 14.9 kV
z 1.0142 as built (the record with its chains 1.0322); the clamps 630 mW; 95 % in 1.45 s; the counter-rotor can float (Q1 = −Q2)
seeds 51 V / 947 V / 4870 V (typical / maximum / hot; the record 122 V / 1.0 kV / 3.65 kV); the rings ±14.67 / ±14.40 / ±13.95 kV, 7.47 / 7.33 / 7.10 kV/cm
the new nodes' strays (24.5 pF each assumed) set the rings: with none they reach ±16.3 kV; trim the clamp strings on the bench before the hub sees it
